# David Plappert

> Principal Cloud Architect & AWS Reliability Lead. 19 years on AWS since EC2 beta. US Patent holder (11,146,689). Two-time AWS City on a Cloud Award winner (2016, 2018). Ships AI-augmented engineering in production today. Based in Peoria, Illinois — open to senior and principal cloud roles (remote, with hybrid or relocation considered).

## About

David Plappert is a principal-level cloud architect and AWS reliability lead with 19 years of AWS experience since EC2 beta (2007). He currently leads AWS reliability for Caterpillar's Vertex 3D platform (via TEKsystems) and is open to new senior and principal individual-contributor roles — Principal Cloud Architect, Staff/Principal Platform Engineer, AWS Reliability Lead, SRE lead, or similar. His focus is production reliability of revenue-critical AWS systems, gatekeeping infrastructure before it ships, distributed systems, and building agentic AI tooling that helps teams move faster without breaking production.

- Amazon Web Services (AWS) City on a Cloud Award (2018) — IdeaCrew's open-source cloud technology recognized for a second time: https://www.prweb.com/releases/ideacrews_open_source_cloud_based_technology_powers_dc_health_link_to_second_prestigious_amazon_award/prweb15631477.htm

- 19 years of AWS experience since EC2 beta (2007)

## What David Does

1. **Vendor-shipped AWS gatekeeping** — senior buy-side review of vendor infrastructure (AWS CDK/CloudFormation) before it reaches production.
2. **Production reliability ownership** — senior AWS architecture, observability design, load testing, and final-escalation coverage for revenue-bearing systems.
3. **AI-augmented engineering** — agentic CI/CD and operations in production: Claude Code workflows that deploy, dry-run, detect bugs, and file tickets, bridged to GitHub and AWS through custom MCP servers and tool definitions David wrote.

## Career

- **Caterpillar Inc. (via TEKsystems) — Lead Cloud Engineer / AWS Reliability Lead (September 2025 – Present)** — AWS reliability lead for Vertex 3D, Caterpillar's real-time 3D collaboration platform powering aftermarket commerce. Sole Caterpillar-side reviewer of monthly vendor-shipped AWS CDK releases. Owns load testing, monitoring, and alerting. Built and operates a Claude Code agentic CI/CD and operations workflow. Cross-team escalation point across AWS and Node.js stacks.
- **IdeaCrew — Principal Cloud Architect & DevOps Lead (2015 – 2025)** — Employee #3 through 100+ employees. Managed $1M/month cloud spend across 12 AWS and 3 Azure accounts. Owned the AWS architecture that won 2× AWS City on a Cloud awards. Architected systems processing $500M+/year in healthcare insurance payments for DCHBX, Massachusetts Health Connector, CoverME, and DC Department of Behavioral Health. 18F advisor. Led the fastest state-based exchange transition off FedHub on record.
- **PBS — Cloud Engineer (2014)** — Built AWS-based RTMP streaming platform with 99.9% uptime; +158% viewer watch time.
- **Argonne National Laboratory — Senior Cloud Architect (2013)** — Federal grant application platform; +283% lab revenue.
- **Best Buy — Senior Cloud DevOps (2012)** — Led migration of BestBuy.com and Point-of-Sale (billion-dollar systems) to AWS; reduced infrastructure costs by 50%+.
